mutation_checks.name: spill-storage-only
mutation_checks.mutation: FILE -> MEMORY only; cache limits unchanged

limitations: shared-host warm synthetic workloads; cache effect is observational, not isolated causal proof
250k P4 target not met; no 10M/HTTP/native enumeration integration, cold cache, Linux or physical power-loss test
FILE spill/cache pragmas pin page-cache policy, not a total-process memory cap or proof of bounded private commit
no commit or push; driver integrates and reviews
origin/main advanced during measurement; benchmarks and gates cover frozen starting main fc79c7f plus this uncommitted extraction, not integration onto 0cc03acd7581c33c0b92a245066553d408193d6f
P4c.disposition: NOT performance-qualified: 224/16 MiB FILE extraction loses 37.5% median P4 against same-session main; larger-cache probes did not establish parity. Bulk remains parked.
P4c.recommended_default: 224 MiB main / 16 MiB temp / FILE / spill ON is the measured memory-first cache-policy choice; it carries the observed throughput cost, not a noise claim. Guard and M1 pin can land independently. Not a total-process memory bound.
